title: Measure with a camera · level 2
brief: The robot stands still with G10.2's camera (Camera Module 3, 640 x 480, 66 degrees; forward 60, left 0), but its tilt (20-30 degrees down) and height (100-160 mm) are drawn for each run and not told: job.json leaves them out. A calibration mat's four corner markers lie flat on the floor, each a 40 mm 2 x 2 checker on a white square, their middles at (420, 180), (420, -180), (680, 180) and (680, -180) mm (x forward, y left, from the axle's middle). Five 30 mm discs (blue, green, red, yellow, black) lie at seeded places 240-800 mm ahead of the axle, within 115 mm of the centre line. Make the frame folder, run your PC program on it, and write each disc's floor position to report.json; Score report scores it. A run scores 100 x clamp(1 - e / 40 mm, 0, 1), e the mean error over the five discs (the pairing with the least total distance; a disc not written counts 40 mm; more than five points score 0).

score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: score >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.reportCount == 5) >= 0.8 * n
